overview_description.description: WIMO is an innovative Last-Mile platform for businesses and enterprises, with customers in many vertical industries ranging from eCommerce and courier companies to banks and real-estate companies. Our solution empowers companies to seamlessly manage their last mile operations and delivery services. In parallel, we always keep the customer at the center of the entire ecosystem by creating a simple and beautifully designed customer experience.
